theme.en: Memory Pressure Rewrites AI's Hardware Roadmap
theme.zh: 存储压力改写AI硬件路线图

dek.en: HBM packaging plans are slowing even as Samsung points to 4 TB/s stacks, while Google is reportedly salvaging DDR4 for new AI servers. Across the stack, memory availability and movement now shape product roadmaps as much as raw compute.
dek.zh: HBM封装计划正在放缓，Samsung却已把单堆栈带宽目标指向4 TB/s；与此同时，据报道Google正从退役服务器中回收DDR4用于新AI服务器。纵观整个硬件栈，存储的供给与数据搬运正与算力本身一样左右产品路线图。

title.en: Optics Still Drives Marvell's AI Business More Than Custom Chips
title.zh: 光互连对Marvell AI业务的推动仍超过定制芯片

summary.en: Optical connectivity remains a larger driver of Marvell's AI business than its custom-chip programs. The mix shows that moving data between accelerators is already a more immediate revenue engine than the longer-cycle effort to win and ramp bespoke silicon.
summary.zh: 光互连对Marvell AI业务的推动仍大于定制芯片项目。这个业务结构表明，在定制芯片经历较长的赢单与量产周期之际，加速器之间的数据搬运已经成为更直接的收入引擎。

title.en: GoPro Enters AI Data-Center Optics Through $285 Million Merger
title.zh: GoPro通过2.85亿美元合并进入AI数据中心光通信市场

summary.en: GoPro is merging with optical-photonics company Starman Optical in a transaction valued at at least $285 million. The deal is expected to eliminate $92 million of GoPro debt, return camera manufacturing to the United States, and add optical transceivers for AI data centers to its portfolio.
summary.zh: GoPro将与光子光学公司Starman Optical合并，交易价值至少2.85亿美元。该交易预计将消除GoPro的9200万美元债务，把相机制造迁回美国，并将面向AI数据中心的光收发器纳入产品组合。

title.en: Intel 18A-P Extends RibbonFET and Backside Power

summary.en: Intel is positioning 18A-P as a performance-enhanced derivative of 18A rather than a conventional new process node. The roadmap extends the first generation of RibbonFET and backside power delivery, making execution and customer portability more important than the marketing name.
summary.zh: Intel把18A-P定位为18A的性能增强衍生版本，而不是传统意义上的新制程。该路线图延续第一代RibbonFET与背面供电，因此实际执行与客户设计迁移能力比制程命名更值得关注。

title.en: TSMC Opens Kaohsiung Supplier Campus for Packaging Validation
title.zh: 台积电在高雄启用供应商园区以补齐封装验证环节

summary.en: TSMC has opened a supplier campus in Kaohsiung aimed at closing gaps in packaging validation. Bringing suppliers and validation work closer together should shorten feedback loops as advanced packaging becomes a larger constraint on AI-chip output.
summary.zh: 台积电在高雄启用供应商园区，目标是补齐封装验证环节的缺口。随着先进封装日益成为AI芯片产出的约束，把供应商与验证工作拉近有望缩短反馈周期。

title.en: Hybrid Bonding Advances in Logic but Slips for HBM
title.zh: 混合键合在逻辑芯片量产，却在HBM上延后

summary.en: Hybrid bonding is in high-volume production for logic, but its adoption in HBM has been postponed as microbumps remain the practical choice. TSMC's current hybrid-bonding pitch sits at 6 microns, underscoring that memory stacks face a different cost and manufacturing tradeoff from logic-on-logic integration.
summary.zh: 混合键合已在逻辑芯片上进入大规模量产，但其在HBM中的采用被推迟，微凸点仍是更现实的选择。台积电当前的混合键合间距为6微米，说明存储堆栈与逻辑芯片对逻辑芯片的集成在成本和制造上面临不同权衡。

title.en: Samsung Targets 4 TB/s per Stack With HBM5
title.zh: Samsung将HBM5单堆栈带宽目标定为4 TB/s

summary.en: Samsung expects HBM5 to deliver 4 TB/s per stack by the late 2020s, roughly twice the performance projected for HBM4E. The company says that level could support AI accelerators with aggregate memory bandwidth near 100 TB/s, although the hinted 4,096-bit interface remains a roadmap inference rather than a disclosed specification.
summary.zh: Samsung预计HBM5将在2020年代末实现单堆栈4 TB/s带宽，约为HBM4E目标性能的两倍。公司称这可支持总存储带宽接近100 TB/s的AI加速器，但外界推测的4096位接口仍只是路线图推断，并非已公布规格。

title.en: Google Reportedly Reuses Retired DDR4 in New AI Servers
title.zh: 据报道Google从退役服务器回收DDR4用于新AI服务器

summary.en: Google is reportedly removing DDR4 modules from retired servers and redeploying them in new AI systems. The unusual reuse program is a tangible sign that hyperscaler bottlenecks have shifted from compute alone toward memory availability and supply-chain access.
summary.zh: 据报道，Google正从退役服务器中拆出DDR4模块，并将其重新部署到新的AI系统。这个非常规再利用计划具体反映出，超大规模数据中心的瓶颈已从单纯算力转向存储供给和供应链获取能力。

title.en: KAIST Targets a Fab Gas 6,000 Times More Potent Than CO2
title.zh: KAIST处理温室效应为CO2约6000倍的晶圆厂气体

summary.en: A KAIST team reports a disorder-based method for taming a semiconductor-process greenhouse gas described as 6,000 times more potent than CO2. If the approach transfers from the laboratory to fab-scale abatement, it could reduce one of chip manufacturing's hard-to-remove climate impacts.
summary.zh: KAIST团队报告了一种利用无序结构处理半导体制程温室气体的方法；该气体的温室效应据称约为CO2的6000倍。如果这种方法能从实验室扩展到晶圆厂规模的尾气处理，它可能降低芯片制造中最难消除的一类气候影响。

title.en: Korea Zinc Expands Semiconductor Sulfuric Acid Capacity to 320,000 Tons
title.zh: Korea Zinc将半导体硫酸产能扩至32万吨

summary.en: Korea Zinc is expanding its semiconductor-grade sulfuric acid capacity to 320,000 tons. The increase adds domestic supply of a high-purity process chemical whose reliability matters directly to fab utilization and contamination control.
summary.zh: Korea Zinc正把半导体级硫酸产能扩大到32万吨。此次扩产增加了高纯度制程化学品的本土供给，而其供应可靠性会直接影响晶圆厂产能利用率与污染控制。

title.en: U.S. Semiconductor Tariffs Are Coming With Carveouts, Lutnick Says
title.zh: Lutnick称美国半导体关税将落地并设豁免条款

summary.en: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick says semiconductor tariffs are coming, but the policy will include carveouts. The unresolved scope of those exemptions is now the key variable for chipmakers and electronics supply chains deciding whether U.S. manufacturing commitments will shield imports from new duties.
summary.zh: 美国商务部长Howard Lutnick表示，半导体关税将会落地，但政策会包含豁免条款。豁免范围尚未确定，这已成为芯片厂商与电子供应链判断在美制造承诺能否使进口产品免受新关税影响的关键变量。

title.en: Broadcom Q3 Revenue Jumps 86% to $29.6 Billion
title.zh: Broadcom第三季度营收增长86%至296亿美元

summary.en: Broadcom's third-quarter revenue rose 86% to $29.6 billion, with AI-chip demand identified as the main driver. The result reinforces that hyperscaler spending is flowing beyond GPUs into custom accelerators, networking, and the surrounding connectivity stack.
summary.zh: Broadcom第三季度营收增长86%，达到296亿美元，AI芯片需求被视为主要驱动力。这一结果再次说明，超大规模客户的支出正从GPU扩展到定制加速器、网络以及周边互连硬件栈。

title.en: Mercedes Spinout Athos Shuts Down After Funding Falls Short
title.zh: Mercedes拆分公司Athos融资未果后停止运营

summary.en: Mercedes spinout Athos has closed after failing to secure the financing needed to continue commercializing its chiplet-based technology. The shutdown is a reminder that architectural differentiation alone does not bridge the capital-intensive path from prototype silicon to a production business.
summary.zh: Mercedes拆分公司Athos因未能获得继续商业化chiplet技术所需的融资而关闭。这次停运提醒市场，单靠架构差异化不足以跨越从原型芯片到量产业务之间的高资本门槛。

theme.en: No New Papers Clear the Queue
theme.zh: 暂无新论文进入阅读队列

dek.en: Today's merged research feed returned no new candidates, so the reading queue remains empty rather than repeating previously covered work.
dek.zh: 今日合并研究源未返回新的候选论文，因此本期阅读队列保持为空，不重复此前已覆盖的研究。
